answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The pearl holds work receipts rather than names, so the bridge of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
